title: TripletAD: Weakly Supervised Anomaly Detection in Embedding Space with Rare Anomalies and Scarce Labels
abstract: arXiv:2611.10352v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As AI and agentic systems automate more processes with less human review, data is increasingly represented, and passed between systems, as embeddings produced by pre-trained models. Detecting rare deviations in these embeddings is becoming a critical guardrail, yet anomaly detection methods were largely developed for hand-built tabular features, where gradient-boosted trees remain the method of choice. We propose TripletAD, a weakly supervised detector for embedding spaces in which anomalies are rare. TripletAD learns a triplet-margin embedding in which every triplet contains an anomaly, so the few anomalies are reused across the entire training set instead of being diluted by it, and calibrates a linear scoring head with a partial cross-entropy on anomalies and a relative-contrast hinge that separates the mean scores of anomalous and normal samples. Across 28 embedding datasets spanning text, images, speech and industrial inspection

translated_title: TripletAD：针对稀有异常和稀缺标签的嵌入空间弱监督异常检测
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能和智能体系统在越来越少的人工审核下自动化更多流程，数据越来越多地以预训练模型生成的嵌入形式来表示，并在系统之间传递。检测这些嵌入中的稀有偏差正成为一项关键的保障措施，然而现有的异常检测方法主要是为手工构建的表格特征而开发的，在这类任务中梯度提升树仍是首选方法。我们提出了TripletAD，这是一种针对异常稀少的嵌入空间的弱监督检测器。TripletAD学习一个三元组间隔嵌入，其中每个三元组都包含一个异常样本，因此少数异常样本在整个训练集中被重复利用，而不是被正常样本稀释；同时通过在异常样本上的部分交叉熵损失和一个能够区分异常与正常样本平均分数的相对对比铰链损失来校准线性评分头。在涵盖文本、图像、语音和工业检测领域的28个嵌入数据集上进行了评估。
tldr: 提出TripletAD弱监督异常检测方法，通过构建每个三元组都包含异常样本的三元组间隔嵌入，并结合部分交叉熵与相对对比铰链损失校准线性评分头，有效解决嵌入空间中异常稀有、标签稀缺的检测难题。
en_tdlr: TripletAD is a weakly supervised anomaly detector for embedding spaces that reuses rare anomalies in every triplet-margin embedding and calibrates a linear scoring head with partial cross-entropy and relative-contrast hinge loss, enabling effective detection of rare anomalies with scarce labels.
